title: Stripe agrees to buy OpenRouter as AI model routing expands
summary: Stripe has agreed to acquire OpenRouter, an AI model-routing platform that provides developers unified access to over 400 AI models from 80+ providers through a single API interface. The acquisition extends Stripe's existing AI billing capabilities with model selection and intelligent routing features.
problem_solved: Developers struggle with integrating and managing multiple AI model providers, each with different APIs, pricing models, and billing systems.
why_valuable: It provides a unified API gateway for AI model access with standardized billing, simplifying the complex landscape of AI provider management for developers.
